transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I guess I’m here because there’s been this situation at work that I haven’t been able to get anyone to really take seriously. I work in computer support, and for over a year now, the new ticket rotation and these security audits… it feels like they’re being used to build a paper trail against me.

Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, and I understand how that sounds, I do. I’m not trying to be difficult. I just… I don’t think it’s as random or routine as they keep saying, and I thought maybe talking to someone outside of work would help.
Have you ever heard, seen, or sensed things that other people don't seem to notice or believe are there?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t seen things or heard voices or anything like that, if that’s what you mean. I’m aware this whole work situation can sound… maybe far-fetched to people, but it’s not like I’m sensing things that aren’t there. At least, not that I’ve noticed.

Aside from this situation at work, do you find yourself generally distrustful or suspicious of other people in your life—like friends, family, or people you meet socially—and has that been a pattern for you going back many years?

No, I wouldn’t say that’s been a pattern for me. I mean, I’m not someone who just automatically assumes the worst about people. I have normal caution, I guess, like anyone does, but with friends or family… no, I don’t think I’m generally suspicious of them.

This work thing feels different to me. I know maybe that sounds like I’m separating it out too neatly, but I really don’t think I’ve gone through life distrusting everyone.
Aside from this work situation, how are things going for you day-to-day—are you keeping up with your usual routines, relationships, and responsibilities the way you always have?

Yes, I think so. I mean… I don’t want to make it sound like everything is perfect, but outside of that work issue, I’m functioning pretty normally.

I keep the house in order, pay the bills, help my wife with what needs doing. And at work, the actual technical part of my job—I’m still doing that. No one’s telling me my work is sloppy or that I’m disorganized, at least not in that sense. So… I think day-to-day I’m keeping up okay, if that answers what you’re asking.
How long has this belief about being targeted at work been going on—can you tell me approximately when it first started?

I think it really started around when the hybrid schedule changed and they started changing the after-hours ticket process. That would be… about a year and two months ago, roughly.

I don’t want to overstate it, but that’s when I first started noticing the pattern, or at least when it began to feel like it wasn’t just normal workplace confusion. Does that make sense?
Have you noticed any changes in your emotions or motivation over this past year—like feeling less interested in things you used to enjoy, withdrawing from people, or feeling emotionally flat or numb?

I don’t think so, not in any major way. I mean, this whole thing has been stressful, so I’m sure I’ve had days where I’m more preoccupied or not as cheerful as usual. But I wouldn’t say I’ve become emotionally numb or stopped caring about things.

I still do the things I normally do, and I’m not trying to cut people off or anything. If I seem quieter sometimes, it’s probably just because I’m thinking about the work situation. But no, I don’t think there’s been some big change in my motivation or personality. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
